description: Compare npm/PyPI download activity for up to 20 packages — last 30 days: total, latest day and average (a longer list is cut and says so). Read-only aggregation of daily-collected observatory data; no side effects. Package download days may be missing (npm/PyPI reporting delay); missing days are null with notes, never fake zeros. Use when the user wants to compare package popularity side by side; for a single package's history use `get_npm_trends` or `get_pypi_trends`.
name: get_package_comparison
title: Get Package Comparison
